settings.repere: Paragraphe · It’s kind of surprising, but sometimes t
settings.text: It’s kind of surprising, but sometimes the healthiest habits you think you have – your daily multivitamins and those green smoothies – might not be giving your body everything it truly needs. Why is that?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Most multi vitamins contain nutrients th
settings.text: Most multi vitamins contain nutrients that have been taken out of their natural food sources.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · But in nature, nutrients NEVER exist alo
settings.text: But in nature, nutrients NEVER exist alone. They come in complete packages with natural cofactors and enzymes that work together to support your body.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Our ancestors understood this instinctiv
settings.text: Our ancestors understood this instinctively. The proteins, fats, vitamins, and minerals in organ meats come together in unique combinations that have been part of traditional diets throughout human history.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · So why is there so much more research ar
settings.text: So why is there so much more research around multi-vitamins than beef organs?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Because most research is funded by big c
settings.text: Because most research is funded by big companies that make synthetic vitamins and supplements. We all know it’s easier and cheaper for them to study and produce a single, isolated vitamin in a lab than to deal with real food, which is more complex – and harder to standardize.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · It makes sense that big companies focus
settings.text: It makes sense that big companies focus on synthetic vitamins. You can’t patent beef liver, but you can patent a vitamin formula and make a lot more money.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · That’s why FEM provides these complete n
settings.text: That’s why FEM provides these complete nutrient packages from grass fed, pasture raised animals.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Unlike isolated vitamins, FEM gives your
settings.text: Unlike isolated vitamins, FEM gives your body access to the same traditional nutrition that generations of women relied on before multivitamins existed.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Our ancestors knew something we’ve forgo
settings.text: Our ancestors knew something we’ve forgotten – that our bodies need specific nutrients from organ meats to keep our hormones working properly.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Without these key nutrients, your hormon
settings.text: Without these key nutrients, your hormones can go completely out of balance, throwing your whole body into chaos.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · We know organ meats might sound weird, a
settings.text: We know organ meats might sound weird, and who has time to cook liver and ovaries every day?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Between work, kids, and everything else,
settings.text: Between work, kids, and everything else, prepping these kinds of foods just isn’t realistic.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · And let’s face it, liver isn’t exactly a
settings.text: And let’s face it, liver isn’t exactly a food most of us crave, right? But here’s the thing: your body is likely missing these nutrients, and you probably don’t have time to fit organ meats into your routine.
